what_happened.line: The Finance Committee heard the police chief's budget request, set against the town manager's recommended level, and the gaps between the two.
Narcan was not funded in the police request; the chief said supplies would be improvised this year and put in next year's budget.
The committee agreed it could recommend looking into a user fee for Narcan.
The fire chief presented a request that asked for more than the target for EMS supplies and vehicle maintenance.
A member agreed to ask the website administrator about a page for budget hearing materials and YouTube links.

why_it_matters: Police training, Narcan, desk coverage and added officers are not fully funded at the manager's recommended level, so any added money would raise the town budget, mostly taxes, or require cuts elsewhere.
A resident at the hearing asked that the full life-cycle cost of a new position, including insurance and retirement, be shown, since staffing is a continuing cost beyond the first year's pay.
watch_next: The remaining budget hearings on the committee's schedule, and whether a website page for hearing materials and YouTube links is set up.
